title: shell-tools features
description: What makes the JSON operations cheap for an agent's context: unchanged markers, diffs, bounded output and batches.

entities.name: Unchanged replies
entities.description: A repeat whose answer the session already received costs a marker.
entities.behavior: Within a session, a read with the same ranges and caps of an unchanged file, or a search, list or outline with an equal result, returns {etag, unchanged: true, ref}. read answers from a trusted stamp without loading the file; if_none_match answers unchanged for any session. fresh:true sends the content again.
entities.outcome: An agent does not pay twice for content it has.
constraints: A stamp inside the racy window is never trusted.

entities.name: Diff replies
entities.description: A whole-file read of a changed file returns only hunks when they are much smaller.
entities.behavior: When the session last received the whole file and holds that version, read returns hunks (at, del, new_at, ins) if they are under half the file. diff_since returns the hunks between any version the session was sent (etag) and the file now.
entities.outcome: Re-reading a changed file costs its change, not its size.
constraints: Diff bases are shared by sessions, 64 MiB in all, files over 8 MiB not kept.

entities.name: Bounded output
entities.description: Every reply is capped and says how to continue.
entities.behavior: read stops at max_lines (400) or max_bytes (16384) with next_ranges and bytes_omitted; lines over 2000 bytes are cut. search keeps max_matches (100) hits and says truncated; list pages with max_entries (500) and next_cursor; outline keeps max_symbols (300).
entities.outcome: A large answer never floods the context.
constraints: Binary files report binary and size only.

entities.name: Request batches
entities.description: An array of requests is answered in order, one reply each.
entities.behavior: Each request is parsed and run on its own; one failing does not stop the rest. all_ok tells whether every reply succeeded; zazzle call exits 1 otherwise.
constraints: Requests in a batch run one after another.

relatedViews.relationship: The call and stat commands that reach them.
